subject: FinBank request: SDLC evidence bundle for upcoming SIG pre-assessment
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG pre-assessment

Aditya —

As discussed on the call, FinBank's risk team is starting a SIG pre-assessment next week and we need a compact set of SDLC artifacts focused on code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change management. Can you provide a single package (index + artifacts) and a short mapping that shows where each SIG question is answered?

Priority items:
- PR review policy and recent PR audit sample (last 30 days)
- CI pipeline run logs for the last successful deployment to prod-like infra
- Evidence of automated secret scanning and how exceptions are handled
- Change approval trail for two recent releases (IDs: rel-20270318, rel-20270409)

We don't need full binaries — hashes/logs/links are fine. Target delivery: 48 hours. Let me know if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Risk Manager, FinBank
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG pre-assessment

Tom —

Received, thanks. 48 hours is tight but doable. I'm pulling together a concise bundle and will share a Drive folder and an index CSV that maps items to SIG/CAIQ questions. Neha — can you pull the PR audit and code-review snapshots (last 30 days)? Mina — can you export the CI logs and change approval traces for rel-20270318 and rel-20270409 and confirm there are no secrets in build logs?

I'll do the mapping doc and package everything. We'll upload a zip and provide signed checksums.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG pre-assessment

Aditya / Mina —

Attached: code-reviews-snapshot.patch (diffs + reviewer metadata) and a short PR-audit-summary.txt that lists all PRs merged in the last 30 days that touched production services. Highlights:
- 72 PRs merged, 2 required escalations to an on-call owner, 0 bypasses of required review (gated by CODEOWNERS + branch protection).
- All PRs show at least one approval and green CI.

Also included a small README that points to our Code Review policy (internal link) and the specific policy lines that satisfy SIG question CC6.1 and CC6.2.

Neha
Engineering Manager, Platform
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T08:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG pre-assessment

Folks —

I exported the CI pipeline evidence and change logs. Items uploaded to Drive (links in index):
- ci_pipeline_logs_20270421.zip (truncated logs, redacted env vars, and step hashes)
- change-approval-trail-rel-20270318.csv (approvers, timestamps, JIRA IDs)
- change-approval-trail-rel-20270409.csv

Secrets controls: we run TruffleHog + internal regex scanners in the pipeline. I included the scan summary and the exception ticket for a false positive we investigated (TKT-4128). No detected secrets in the exported logs — verified and redacted where needed.

Mina
Head of Platform Reliability
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com>, GraceTech Security <assessor@gracetech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG pre-assessment

Tom / GraceTech —

We uploaded a compact evidence bundle to Drive and zipped a delivery artifact. Contents (index attached as sdlc_evidence_index.csv):
- code-reviews-snapshot.patch — sample diffs + reviewer metadata (last 30 days)
- PR-audit-summary.txt — summary of PR gating and policy references
- ci_pipeline_logs_20270421.zip — truncated, redacted pipeline logs with step checksums
- change-approval-trail-rel-20270318.csv, change-approval-trail-rel-20270409.csv — approver IDs, timestamps, JIRA links
- secret-scan-summary-20270421.txt — TruffleHog and regex results + exception ticket TKT-4128

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E_finbank-evidence
Delivery zip (MD5): sdlc_evidence_finbank_20270423.zip : md5=9b8f6a1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c
HubSpot: HubSpot-678942 (attached to FinBank opportunity)

Let me know if you need specific snippets inline instead of Drive links or if the assessor needs additional attestations (signed statements from approvers).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:12 AM Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com> wrote:
> Aditya —
>
> Thanks for the quick response. Drive link works. For the SIG pre-assessment we prefer a short mapping doc that points each SIG question to the artifact and line/section that demonstrates compliance. If you can include that in the index CSV that will speed review.
>
> Appreciate it,
> Tom
